Metadata.title: Natural Land CR — Nature tours in Costa Rica
Metadata.description: Locally guided tours to Costa Rica's volcanoes, cloud forests, rivers and beaches. Small groups and responsible travel.

Home.heroTitle: Costa Rica through the eyes of a naturalist guide.
Home.heroSubtitle: Guided tours led by specialists in wildlife and nature photography.
Home.introTitle: Expeditions that connect you with nature.
Home.introLead: Natural Land CR is a Costa Rican company specializing in nature tourism. We design and run expeditions, private tours and experiences focused on birdwatching, wildlife, photography and environmental education.
Home.introText1: We work across Costa Rica’s many ecosystems, creating personalized experiences for those who want to discover the country’s biodiversity in a close, authentic and responsible way.
Home.introText2: Our approach combines naturalist knowledge, field experience and a passion for photography and wildlife. Each expedition is about much more than spotting species: we want to share their stories, understand their behavior and show the role every organism plays within its ecosystem.

local.title: Local guides
local.text: Our certified guides specialize in each activity and are selected according to the destination and type of experience. Their knowledge and field experience ensure professional, personalized guidance focused on enjoying and understanding Costa Rica’s nature.

small.title: Private groups
small.text: Enjoy private expeditions and experiences designed around each group’s interests, pace and needs. No shared itineraries, just personalized attention and the freedom to experience Costa Rica’s nature your way.

responsible.title: Responsible tourism and conservation
responsible.text:
At Natural Land CR, we believe every expedition should be a positive experience for both our visitors and nature. We promote responsible tourism grounded in respect for biodiversity, local communities and our ecosystems.

We run conservation programs and take part in Blue Flag (Bandera Azul) initiatives, and we include environmental education activities in our expeditions. We want every traveler not only to get to know Costa Rica, but also to understand why protecting its natural resources matters.
responsible.motto: We explore, we learn, we protect.

Privacy.metaDescription: How Natural Land CR collects, uses and protects the personal data you send us.
Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.subtitle: What data we collect when you write to us, what we use it for and how you can ask us to delete it.

sections.title: Who is responsible for your data
sections.text: Natural Land CR is responsible for the personal data you send us through this site. For any question about your data, write to info@naturallandcr.com.

sections.title: What data we collect
sections.text: When you fill out the “Plan your trip” form we collect your first name, last name, email address, phone number, nationality and the message you write. We also store the date you accepted this policy and an encrypted fingerprint of your IP address, which cannot be used to recover the original address and only helps us prevent abusive submissions.

sections.title: What we use it for
sections.text: We use your data only to answer your request, prepare a trip proposal and contact you about it. We do not sell your data or share it with third parties for advertising.

sections.title: Legal basis
sections.text: We process your data because you give us your consent by ticking the box on the form. You can withdraw it at any time by writing to us.

sections.title: Who else processes it
sections.text: To work, the site relies on providers that process data on our behalf: Vercel (site hosting), Neon (database), our email provider, Google reCAPTCHA (protection against automated submissions) and Google Analytics (visit statistics). Some of these services store information outside Costa Rica, mainly in the United States.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.text: We keep your request for as long as it is useful to serve you or until you ask us to delete it. You can ask us to delete it at any time.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: You can ask us to access, correct or delete your data, or object to its use (rights recognized by Costa Rica's Law 8968 on the Protection of Individuals regarding the Processing of their Personal Data, and by the GDPR if you are in the European Union). Write to info@naturallandcr.com from the email you used for your request and we will reply within the legal time limit.

sections.title: How we protect it
sections.text: Connections to the site are encrypted, the database is only accessible to the authorized team through verified sign-in, and we limit repeated submissions to prevent abuse.

sections.title: Cookies and statistics
sections.text: We use Google Analytics to know how many people visit the site and which pages interest them. Google Analytics uses cookies; you can block or delete them in your browser settings. The form uses Google reCAPTCHA, which is subject to Google's privacy policy and terms of service.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.text: If we change this policy, we will publish the new version on this page with its update date.
